text_block_list.text: While stopping by the department store basement on a whim, I spotted Eishin Flash doing some shopping.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: We have most of the ingredients ready now, so all that's left is a few pieces of fruit...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-san.
Good afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"A friend mentioned wanting to make Valentine's chocolates,
so I was thinking of preparing a few prototypes."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Not just ordinary chocolates,
I plan to try various things like simple cupcakes too.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"If you're interested,
would you like to come observe?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It will begin... precisely
1 hour and 33 seconds from now, however.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Please accompany me for a little shopping, then.
I estimate we will need about 20 minutes.

I helped her finish the rest of the shopping,
and together we headed to the cafeteria kitchen.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
――Now then, preparations are complete.
We have some break time before starting,
so let me brew some tea first.
choice_data_list: Those clothes look great on you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Is that so?
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I am truly glad and honored to receive such praise from you.
...It makes all the agonizing worth it."
choice_data_list: I think it's a good design.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I believe we were only able to bring this design to life thanks to the artisan's skill.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
We chose the base from a catalog
and had it made according to the pastry chef's vision.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I received several rough samples,
and every single design was so lovely that I just couldn't make up my mind...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
But... while I was lost in thought,
I suddenly remembered the sight of my father's face.
The look on his face whenever he was making sweets.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"And then, a design naturally popped into my head.
Ah, this is what I've been searching for... I thought."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, it is different from
what my father wears, but there are
definitely shared elements as well."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My father's serious gaze, his burning passion...
That is his "pride" as a pâtissier.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I am not yet a professional in that field.
Even so, I wanted to embody the pride and dignity
of my father as a pâtissier.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No matter how minor the task, give it your all,
putting your utmost care and devotion into it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"The smiles that sweets bring... I believe they come
not just from the taste, but from the heart
of the person who made them."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
And each of the smiles brought to light
becomes something truly irreplaceable.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No matter where one wears this,
this is something that must never be forgotten...
is that it?

A prototype made for her friend.
Even if it's not the real deal, you can tell how seriously she's taking it.
Anyone who gets to eat Eishin Flash's sweets is truly blessed... I couldn't help but feel that way.
When I spoke my mind honestly—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: GlÃ¼ck... happiness, is it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...If that happens,
will it bring you happiness, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: —Two minutes until cooking begins.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Once it's done... would you like a taste?

—And so,
I watched Eishin Flash's deft handiwork
as she made sweets.

A variety of sweets lined the table,
and a sweet, gentle aroma enveloped the area.
Overcome with emotion, I let out a soft gasp—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Yes, that's the exact smile right there.
There stood Eishin Flash, gently caressing her outfit with a serene smile on her face.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...I would be glad if that were the case.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...I intend to give my all for this prototype as well,
so that they will be pleased with it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However, separate from that,
I'd also like to inspect what kind
of chocolates they have on display.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I hear famous shops from all over will soon
be gathering at the department store for Valentine's, so—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: When that time comes... would you like to go see it together?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Fufu.
As Eishin Flash made the sweets, she seemed to be enjoying herself, yet there was a certain dignity to her—
Seeing him like that made me think he might truly be the father she had spoken of.
